beats.text: Why is sex not gross? Think about it.
Ninety women watched one of three films: erotica, extreme sports, or a train ride.
Then came the gross part. Drink from a cup with a bug in it. Handle a condom that looked used.
The aroused group found the sexual tasks less disgusting, and was more willing to do them.
Arousal turns the disgust dial down. Otherwise, sex would be pretty hard to go through with.
So if things feel weird afterwards? That's just the dial turning back up.

sources: Borg & de Jong (2012). Feelings of disgust and disgust-induced avoidance weaken following induced sexual arousal in women. PLoS ONE 7(9): e44111. 90 heterosexual women randomly assigned to erotic film, sports (general arousal) or train-ride film; 16 tasks (e.g. cup with fake insect, seemingly used condom, used-looking tissue). Sexual arousal group rated sexual tasks less disgusting and was more willing to perform tasks. Via ScienceDaily / Sex & Psychology.
